properties.disease overview: RNA virus infection of the liver with high chronicity rate; long-term complications include cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Commonly associated with blood exposure (e.g., IVDU).
properties.mechanism: Enveloped +ssRNA flavivirus. Persistent infection driven by immune evasion; liver injury largely immune-mediated. Diagnosis: anti-HCV indicates exposure, but active infection requires HCV RNA. Direct-acting antivirals (DAAs) can cure; no vaccine available.
